title: Dyalisix's Warcrimes
description: A small mod that adds some new vanilla-ish ways to fight other people.
body:
Dyalisix's warcrimes is a mod that aims to add several new ways to fight in PvP or against mobs.

This mod adds explosive arrows, toxic arrows, orbital Lasers, combat drugs, combat armor. lots of new explosives, uranium, and a few new enchantments.

This mod is not fully survival compatible ATM, so some things are not craftable or are unattainable. 

Ask me any questions you have on discord. loafer0190
